$comment: The source of sf-chat-message's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9, vocabulary 1.1.5. Moved from simai/ui-chat components/src/smart/chat-message (smart.manifest.json 0.3.1, ui-chat 10d376b) by the D31 move, step 5 (owner yes 2026-10-27), with the message view of component/chat it drew on (render.js, people.js as the template person, sanitize.js, the message's words of strings.js, chat.css and people.css); written by hand on the shape of sf-chat-interlocutor and sf-chat-composer (steps 3 and 4), since migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs takes only the pinned 66 and needs stand 17's output. x-decisions says how each point was decided.

message.x-markup: the message: for the template default an API.md Message ({id, role: user|assistant, status, html, text, sources, verification, stage, notices, proposal, brief, feedback, summary, limit_resets_at, finished_at, attachments}), for the template person a conversation message ({id, body, authorName, createdAt, isEdited, isDeleted, canEdit, canDelete, files, local}); a property or the JSON island; its texts are drawn as text and its html is sanitized
message.summary: The message, a property or the JSON island; texts are drawn as text, html is sanitized.

display.x-markup: what the host knows that the server does not, the 0.3 property view: wait (delayed|stopped|network), busy, feedback ({value, reason, note, asking, draft}), retried, note (confirm|cancel|repeat) and code, sources_open, brief ({live, answer}) and brief_draft; for the template person own, first, last, showName, editing ({body}) and askDelete. Drafts in it (feedback.draft, brief_draft, editing.body) are written in place, so a host that keeps the object keeps them across redraws
display.summary: What the host knows that the server does not (the 0.3 view): wait, busy, feedback, retried, note, code, sources_open, brief, brief_draft; for person own, first, last, showName, editing, askDelete.

features.x-markup: what the surface offers: the rating, a proposal's card, the memory notices and the task brief (API.md v1.2, off unless asked)
features.summary: What the surface offers: rating, proposals, memory notices, the task brief.

retry.x-summary: «Повторить» (vocabulary §5 retry): a failed answer {id}; a person's unsent message {key} (its client key); a person's failed file {id, key, kind: file}.
retry.summary: «Повторить» (vocabulary §5 retry): a failed answer {id}; a person's unsent message {key} (its client key); a person's failed file {id, key, kind: file}. The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: retry, id} follows it until 2026-12-01.

check.x-summary: «Обновить» on a stopped, delayed or lost wait: ask the host whether the answer came (the chat's own check, vocabulary 1.1.3 §5.1).
check.summary: «Обновить» on a stopped, delayed or lost wait: ask the host whether the answer came (the chat's own check, vocabulary 1.1.3 §5.1). The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: check} follows it until 2026-12-01.

rate.x-summary: «Полезно» or «Не полезно» {id, value: up|down} (vocabulary §5 rate); «Отправить» in the «why» card {id, value: down, reason, note}. The buttons show the rating at once; the host keeps it in display.feedback.
rate.summary: «Полезно» or «Не полезно» {id, value: up|down} (vocabulary §5 rate); «Отправить» in the «why» card {id, value: down, reason, note}. The buttons show the rating at once; the host keeps it in display.feedback. The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: feedback / feedback-send} follows it until 2026-12-01.

cancel.x-summary: «Не сейчас» or Escape in the «why» card {id, kind: rate} (vocabulary §5 cancel): the plain «not helpful» stays.
cancel.summary: «Не сейчас» or Escape in the «why» card {id, kind: rate} (vocabulary §5 cancel): the plain «not helpful» stays. The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: feedback-skip} follows it until 2026-12-01.

drafted.x-summary: The «why» card's choice or note changed {id, reason, note} (a fact; the draft is also kept in display.feedback.draft).
drafted.summary: The «why» card's choice or note changed {id, reason, note} (a fact; the draft is also kept in display.feedback.draft). The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: feedback-draft} follows it until 2026-12-01.

toggle.x-summary: A local part opened or closed (vocabulary §5 toggle): the sources list {kind: sources} (the host remembers it as display.sources_open); for the template person the editor {kind: edit} and the delete question {kind: delete}, which the host holds as display.editing and display.askDelete.
toggle.summary: A local part opened or closed (vocabulary §5 toggle): the sources list {kind: sources} (the host remembers it as display.sources_open); for the template person the editor {kind: edit} and the delete question {kind: delete}, which the host holds as display.editing and display.askDelete. The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: sources} follows it until 2026-12-01.

copied.x-summary: The answer was copied, with its sources as a list {id, done}; the action row says it politely.
copied.summary: The answer was copied, with its sources as a list {id, done}; the action row says it politely. The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: copy} follows it until 2026-12-01.

submit.x-summary: A brief's answer goes out as a message (vocabulary §5 submit; API.md v1.2): an option, the person's own words, several answers joined by «; » with «—» for a skipped one, or the card's «Да».
submit.summary: A brief's answer goes out as a message (vocabulary §5 submit; API.md v1.2): an option, the person's own words, several answers joined by «; » with «—» for a skipped one, or the card's «Да». The 0.3 sf-chat-action {action: brief-answer} follows it until 2026-12-01.

save.x-summary: The template person: an edited message {id, values: {body}} (vocabulary §5 save, port message.edit). Unchanged or empty text is a toggle {kind: edit, open: false} instead.
save.summary: The template person: an edited message {id, values: {body}} (vocabulary §5 save, port message.edit). Unchanged or empty text is a toggle {kind: edit, open: false} instead.

delete.x-summary: The template person: «Удалить» confirmed {ids: [id]} (vocabulary §5 delete, port message.delete).
delete.summary: The template person: «Удалить» confirmed {ids: [id]} (vocabulary §5 delete, port message.delete).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16); it places the view's node (js/view/message.js).

person.$comment: A conversation between people (D31 inventory §3: people.js is a template, not a tag); it places js/view/person.js's node.

accessibility.x-keys: A message is an article named «Помощник» or «Вы» (the template person: the author or «Вы»); a pending answer is aria-busy. Copy, rating, sources and footnotes are native buttons with names; a footnote opens the sources at its source and focuses it; the result of copy and rating is said by a polite region in the action row; a failure and a lost connection are role=alert. In the «why» card Enter sends and Escape puts it away; in a brief Enter in «Свой вариант» answers; in the editor of the template person Enter saves, Shift+Enter breaks the line and Escape cancels; the delete question takes the focus on «Отмена».

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-chat-message for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). The 0.3 general sf-chat-action {action, ...} is split by verb (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1); every row needs the element's detail adapter (sfAliasAdapters), which makes the 0.3 detail from the new one.

rows.note: the 0.3 {action: retry, id}; a person's retry (key, kind) has no 0.3 form and sends no old event; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: check, id}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: feedback, id, value}, or {action: feedback-send, id, reason, note} when the rating carries a reason or a note; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: feedback-skip, id} for kind rate; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: feedback-draft, id, reason, note}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: sources, id, open} for kind sources; edit and delete (the template person) send no old event; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: copy, id, done}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 {action: brief-answer, id, text}; the element's adapter (sfAliasAdapters) puts action back
the 0.3 property view (what the window knows), renamed: view is a name the base reserves; the old property reads and writes display

x-summary: One chat message: an assistant's answer with its markup, sources, verification, notices, proposal, rating and task brief, or its wait; a person's question with its files; or, in the template person, a message of a conversation between people. It reports what a person does; the host decides what it means.

x-source.converted: by hand (D31 step 5): convert-1.3.8.mjs reads stand 17's output, which has no chat component

x-renamed: properties.view → the setting display (view is a name the base reserves, §3.1); the old property a dated setting alias until 2026-12-01

events.sf-chat-action {action, ...} → one event per verb (vocabulary §5.1 one name per verb), the old name a dated split alias until 2026-12-01 whose adapter puts action back: retry {id} → retry {id}; check {id} → check {id}; feedback {id, value} → rate {id, value}; feedback-send {id, reason, note} → rate {id, value: down, reason, note}; feedback-skip {id} → cancel {id, kind: rate}; feedback-draft {id, reason, note} → drafted; sources {id, open} → toggle {id, kind: sources, open}; copy {id, done} → copied {id, done}; brief-answer {id, text} → submit {id, text}

the template person (ui-chat people.js, the pilot's renderPersonMessage, which had no element): edit → save {id, values: {body}}, delete → delete {ids}, retry {clientKey} → retry {key}, retry-file {messageId, fileKey} → retry {id, key, kind: file}, edit-start / edit-cancel → toggle {kind: edit, open}, delete-ask / delete-cancel → toggle {kind: delete, open}; new names only, nothing to alias

words: the message's keys of ui-chat's strings.js → lang/<locale>.json runtime words, the dotted key in kebab-case (stage.queued → stage-queued, brief.otherLabel → brief-other-label); the view keeps calling ctx.words with the 0.3 keys and the element maps them (wordName)

css: component/chat/css/chat.css and people.css → js/templates/default.css; the --sf-chat--* tokens → --sf-chat-message--*, set on .sf-chat-message-host (and .sf-chat-surface, :host for a page or a widget without the element) instead of :root; five public variables --sf-chat-message-<name> under the ones a host adapted
x-decisions: version: 0.3.1 in simai/ui-chat → 1.0.0 here: the first release in ui-pro, with the events renamed under dated aliases (simai.linkage 1.0.0: the files changed).

shape: a leaf (D31 inventory §3). sf-message-log stays a chat-agnostic feed; the window sets log.renderMessage to place an sf-chat-message per message (or to call the exported renderMessage for the widget), so the chat's fields (sources, verification, stage, rating, brief) never enter the shared log.

the view stays plain DOM (js/view/message.js, js/view/person.js, the 0.3 render.js and people.js with their imports changed), built once per change and handed to Lit as one node, as ui-chat's ChatElement did: an open «why» card, a brief's typed answer and a proposal's pressed card keep their nodes and focus, and the site widget and the pilot, which have no Framework runtime, can call renderMessage from a pinned ui-pro revision.

people: the template person (D31 inventory §3: a second template of the same component, not a tag), selected by the attribute template=person; display carries own, first, last, showName, editing and askDelete as people.js's view did.

file chip: sf-chat-composer owns it (js/templates/parts.js, step 4); the message imports it by relative path, as sf-data-view imports from table, renders it into its DOM with Lit and adds, for a sent file with href, the download link and the HEAD check: on 404 or 410 the name loses its link and the line says «Файл удалён» (role=status). The composer's files are not changed; its chip rules and the message's are both unscoped class markup, so the message scopes its own to .sf-chat-message and .sf-chat-person.

sanitize: SF.sanitizeHtml(html, {codeLanguage: true, document}) and SF.safeHref, Core's (src/core/js/sanitize.js, made from ui-chat's copy: the same allow-list, incl. h2 h3 h4 del). 1.0.1: framework.lock.json pins ui-source 465fbee (pair ui-194f75ac620f), which has them since 4d711d2 (pair ui-89834691fb9d), so the component's copy js/view/sanitize.js and the fallback are removed; message.js imports core/js/sanitize.js, which publishes SF.sanitizeHtml and SF.safeHref on a page where core.js has not run and never replaces Core's, and calls SF's. The probe's sanitize cases (p1, p9) run against Core's.

proposal: the message places sf-change-confirm (attributes heading, heading-level 2, change-id, state, expires-at, changes as JSON, accept-text «Подтвердить», decline-text «Отменить»), one card per code kept across redraws; its sf-change-confirm-answer bubbles through the message to the window, which sends the proposal's command. The chat's other words for the card («Отменено», the expiry sentence) are registered by the window (ui-chat chat-core/larena.js registerLarenaWords), not by the message: registering another component's words is a page's act.

events: sf-chat-action {action, ...} is split by verb (vocabulary §5.1): retry, check, rate, cancel, toggle, submit (§5, chat 1.1.3 check) and two facts of the chat's own, drafted and copied (own-verb). copy and sources are local (D31 inventory §1) but stay as facts, since the window keeps an open sources list across redraws. The old name follows until 2026-12-01 as split rows whose adapter makes the 0.3 detail; the person's events had no element before and have no alias.

display: the 0.3 property view, renamed because view is a name the base reserves; a dated setting alias keeps el.view until 2026-12-01. Setting message, display or features (even the same object again) redraws the view, as the 0.3 setters did.

words: lang/ru.json and lang/en.json, runtime only, ru the source language; the view asks for the 0.3 dotted keys and the element maps them to the kebab names (wordName). The copy label of a highlighted code block is the word code-copy.

network: host-only. The one request is the HEAD check of a sent file's own download address before following it (Mirai24 27.10: a file deleted from «Мои файлы» keeps its attachment); the address is the host's, never built here.

first paint (§5.4): no late data. The message comes with the host's state; the printed markup is the message as drawn. The element reads no clock: times are the message's own (finished_at, createdAt, limit_resets_at, read_at) in the reader's zone, so a snapshot depends on the zone it was taken in (the examples avoid times).

css-variables: five public variables in the Framework's form (single dash, read with the token as fallback, never set): the reading column, the text, the muted text, the bubble and the edges. Their fallbacks are the tokens chat.css gave the same places.
standard 1.4 (2026-10-29): component.json and examples.json in the 1.4 form, the other files generated by ui-source scripts/generate-component-files.mjs.

$comment: A message draws the Framework's plain markup: icon buttons (copy, rating,
a chip's remove), buttons (a brief's options, the «why» card, the person's
editor) and inputs («Свой вариант», the note of a rating); every glyph is a
Smart sf-icon, and a proposal is the package's sf-change-confirm. A tag it
renders is a tag it fetches. Code blocks go through SF.Highlight when the
page has it; the message does not bring it.

message.const: API.md Message for the template default: {id, role: user|assistant, status: queued|running|completed|partial|failed|refused|withheld|limit, stage, html, text, sources [{n, kind, title, url, excerpt, read_at}], verification, notices, proposal {code, title, state, expires_at, changes}, brief (v1.2 {decision: ask|card, lead, questions|card}), feedback, summary {text}, limit_resets_at, finished_at, attachments [{id, name, bytes, href}]}. For the template person: {id, body, authorName, createdAt, isEdited, isDeleted, canEdit, canDelete, files [{id, key, name, size, state, downloadUrl}], local {state, action, clientKey, body}}.

sanitize.const: message.html is cleaned by SF.sanitizeHtml (codeLanguage), Core's, with the allow-list: p br strong em code pre ul ol li blockquote a table thead tbody tr th td h2 h3 h4 del; links http, https, mailto or root-relative, with rel=noopener noreferrer nofollow and target=_blank.

brief.const: Live (display.brief.live) the brief asks: one question sends its option or own words at once; several are answered together, joined by «; » with «—» for a skipped optional one; the card sends its confirm word. Not live it is a record, the taken option marked from display.brief.answer. The lead, when given, stands for the html.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: fetching or polling the chat API
sending a rating, an answer or an edit

untrusted_inputs: message texts, source titles and excerpts (drawn as text)
download addresses (the host's, used as given)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chat-message for one chat message: a window places it in sf-message-log through the log's renderMessage hook; a page that shows one message (a preview) places it alone. The template person draws a conversation between people.
do_not: Do not stack sf-chat-message elements into a conversation yourself; sf-message-log keeps the reading position and the announcements
Do not put trusted markup into message.html; it is sanitized, and only the allow-list survives
Do not decide a proposal in the message; answer sf-change-confirm-answer in the window
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-chat-message></sf-chat-message> with element.message = {id: 'msg_03', role: 'assistant', status: 'completed', text: 'Ежегодный отпуск — 28 календарных дней.'}

changes: moved from simai/ui-chat to ui-pro (D31): standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9, the element is made from component.json; the view (render.js, people.js as the template person, sanitize.js as a fallback) is the component's js/view; words in lang/; dated aliases in aliases.json; nothing imported from ui-chat
property view -> the setting display until 2026-12-01 (setting alias)

The first-paint snapshot's sheets.json lists the utility sheets its markup uses (retaken on ui-source 5ba9399); no behaviour changed. Nothing to change for a host.

template.description: default: an assistant's answer or a person's question (API.md Message); person: a message of a conversation between people.
